message.content: Find me papers on entity resolution for people with identical names. I want to see if any of it applies to turbolay.

input.query: author name disambiguation same name entity resolution

content.content: S2AND: A Benchmark and Evaluation System for Author Name Disambiguation (arXiv 2103.07534)

content.text: S2AND is the closest match. By turbolay, do you mean HydraDB?

message.content: Yes, turbolay = hydradb, I use the two interchangeably. You'll see me write turbo lay sometimes too.

content.text: Got it. S2AND clusters author mentions using name, affiliation and co-author signals, which maps onto the people-merge problem in HydraDB.

message.content: Nice. Send the link to CK, he owns that area.

content.text: I can't send messages from here, but the link is https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.07534.
